# ms: # A turn interrupted with Escape while a shell tool was running.
# Interrupt fires carrying reason=user_interrupt, which is what the port maps to
# idle/cancelled. Both AgentEnd and Stop carry stop_reason=aborted, and neither is
# read by upstream's mapping or by this port, so the LAST report of a cancelled
# turn carries reason=turn_complete rather than cancelled. The lane is idle
# throughout and correct; only the reason a later reader sees is the weaker one.
# The order of Interrupt against AgentEnd is not stable. This capture has Interrupt
# first; an earlier capture in the same session had AgentEnd first. Stop is last in
# both. Nothing in the port depends on which, because all three report idle.
